crossRefs.note: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two…
Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two…

translations.web: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
translations.bsb: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
translations.kjv: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
translations.asv: Two tenons shall there be in each board, joined one to another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
